sources.title: AMS2 v1.5.5.2 - Extended Car Info v1.0.34
sources.author: Coanda
sources.notes: Forum post labels the sheet AMS2 1.5.5.2 / spreadsheet 1.0.34 and explicitly states that blank indicator cells mean No. The importer projects only authentic-control fields and applies that blank rule to Auto Blip and Shift Cut. Initial records paraphrase selected factual cells; bulk redistribution requires a separate reuse review.

sources.title: Locally observed SimHub AMS2 car identity settings
sources.notes: SimHub 9.11.22 generated .shcarsettings files for locally observed AMS2 cars. The audit found 191 unique identities, with CarId equal to CarModel in every file. Used only to support exact telemetry-name aliases.
